text: November 2026. A developer bought a $300 embroidery machine. Then learned it *needed a subscription.* So they built their own app. In Rust. *Free and open source.* It turns drawings into stitches, sends them to the machine over Bluetooth, and even lets AI agents design with you. They posted it on Hacker News: *740 upvotes.* Save this if you're tired of subscriptions.
title: The Subscription That Started an App 🧵✨
